description:
Get a specific secondary image of a product from Holded.

Args:
  - product_id (string): The product ID (required)
  - image_file_name (string): The image file name (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Product secondary image data (URL or base64 encoded).

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_get_product_secondary_image
title: Get Holded Product Secondary Image
